words.zh: n. 互动；相互作用，相互影响；交流
words.example: Positive interaction between students and teachers improves the learning environment.

words.zh: v. 相异；（根据情况）变化；使多样化；改变
words.example: The colors of autumn leaves vary from bright red to deep orange and gold.

words.zh: v. 挪用；拨款；私占（读作/əˈprəʊprieɪt/）；  adj. 合适的，适当的（读作/əˈprəʊpriət/）；【化】适当的，恰当的
words.example: Please wear appropriate shoes for the physical education class on Monday.

words.zh: phr. 相比之下；相反
words.example: By contrast, the northern part of the country receives very little rain.

words.zh: v. 批准，称许；批准；赞成；满意；同意；通过
words.example: The principal will approve the plan if it includes safety measures for students.

words.zh: v. （用实例、实验）论证；演示，展示；示范；示威；表现，表达；说明
words.example: The teacher asked me to demonstrate how to solve the equation step by step.

words.zh: n. 手势，姿势；姿态；(外交等方面的)姿态，表示；  v. 做手势，用动作示意
words.example: A thumbs-up gesture can mean approval in many cultures.

words.zh: v. 目击，亲眼看见；为……作证；见证；  n. 目击者；证人；证据，证言
words.example: Did anyone witness the accident outside the school gate yesterday afternoon?

words.zh: vt. 雇用；使忙于，使从事；使用；应用；  n. 受雇；使用；职业；雇用，受雇；服务
words.example: The company plans to employ more engineers to develop clean energy technology.

words.zh: n. 完全相同的事物；  adj. 相同的，同一的；一模一样的；(双胞胎)同卵的；【计】一致；【化】相同的
words.example: The twin sisters wore identical dresses to the school dance last Friday.

words.zh: v. 口译；解释；【计】解释；  vt. 把……理解（解释）为
words.example: It is important to interpret body language correctly during cross-cultural communication.

words.zh: vi. 相异，不同于；不同意；有异议
words.example: People from different regions may differ greatly in their customs and traditions.

words.zh: phr. （与……）相比较；比较起来
words.example: By comparison, studying online requires more self-discipline than attending class in person.

words.zh: vt. （口语）无礼地说；  n. 面颊，脸蛋；脸颊
words.example: She kissed her grandmother on the cheek before leaving for school.

words.zh: n. 帮助，恩惠，好事；赞同；偏爱；善意的行为；  v. 偏爱，较喜欢；选择；有利于
words.example: Could you do me a favour and carry these books to the library?

words.zh: vi. 鞠躬，弯腰；点头，垂首；  vt. 低（头）；  v. 使弯曲，屈从（读作/baʊ/）；  n. 鞠躬；弓；蝴蝶结；船头（读作/boʊ/）
words.example: In Japan, people often bow when they greet someone in a formal situation.

words.zh: n. 腰
words.example: The dancer moved her waist gracefully to the rhythm of the music.

words.zh: phr. 推断；推理
words.example: Readers must make inferences from clues in the story to understand the ending.

words.zh: phr. （机器等）发生故障，抛锚；失败；（精神）垮下来；分解；消除；打破；（谈判等）失败，分解
words.example: The old car broke down on the highway, so we called for help.

words.zh: n. 障碍；隔阂；壁垒；障碍物；栅栏；界线；障碍，壁垒
words.example: Language is often a barrier for international students trying to make new friends.

words.zh: v. 假造，杜撰；伪造；冒充，假装；假装；  n. 骗子；假货，赝品；  adj. 假的，假装的，冒充的
words.example: He used a fake smile to hide his disappointment about the game results.

words.zh: n. 怒气；愤怒；  vt. 激怒，使生气
words.example: She tried to control her anger when the printer jammed again.

words.zh: n. 可靠的人；  adj. 可靠的，可信赖的；真实可信的
words.example: The bus timetable is usually reliable, so we can plan our trip accordingly.

words.zh: n. 事件；事故，严重事件；事变，（军事）冲突；【财】事件，事变；【航】事件；  adj. 【法】附带的；【光】入射的；易发生的，伴随而来的
words.example: The teacher recorded the incident in the class log and informed the parents.

words.zh: v. 审讯，审判，试验，试用；  n. 审判，审讯；试验；试用；考验；预赛；试验，测试；【化】试验，实验；  adj. 试验的，试验性的；考验的；审判的
words.example: The new teaching method will be tested in a trial with two classes this term.

words.zh: adj. 轻微的，微小的；略微的，细小的；纤细的，瘦弱的；少量的；细长的；脆弱的；  n. 轻视，蔑视；  vt. 轻视，忽略
words.example: There was a slight change in the schedule, so we left ten minutes later.

words.zh: adv. 稍微，轻微地；纤细地；略微；轻微地
words.example: The temperature dropped slightly during the night, so we needed extra blankets.

words.zh: adj. 孪生的；双胞胎之一的；成双的；  n. 孪生儿；双胞胎之一
words.example: My twin sister and I share the same desk in our classroom.

words.zh: adj. 不使用动词的；不使用语言的；不涉及言语的，非言语的
words.example: Nonverbal communication, such as eye contact, can express more than words.

words.zh: n. 评估，估价；评价；评定；【化】评估，测定
words.example: The teacher gave a quick assessment to see if we understood the grammar lesson.

words.zh: vt. 评估；估值；评价；计算， 估计
words.example: After the experiment, we need to assess how accurately we recorded the data.

words.zh: adj. 体内的，内部的；里面的；国内的；内在的；内心的；【计】内部的；  n. 内部器官
words.example: The doctor checked the patient's internal organs after the accident.

words.zh: phr. 使整齐；整理，直起来
words.example: Please straighten up your desk before the teacher arrives.

words.zh: v. 突然倒下；暴跌；  vi. 垂头弯腰地走（或坐等）；  n. 下降；经济萧条时期
words.example: If you slump in your chair, the teacher may think you are bored.

words.zh: n. 姿势；装腔作势，伪装；  vi. 摆造型；  vt. 引起，导致，造成；主张，提出；假扮，冒充
words.example: The photographer asked us to hold a natural pose for the class picture.

words.zh: v. （使）弯曲；（使）改变（主意）；使屈服；倾斜；偏向；弯曲；  n. （复数形式）减压症；弯曲，弯曲处；倾向，屈服
words.example: You need to bend your knees when you pick up a heavy box.

words.zh: vt. 揭示；透露；显示；  v. 露出，展示
words.example: A smile can reveal a person's true feelings more than words.

words.zh: v. 阐明，澄清；净化；澄清
words.example: Could you clarify your opinion so we can understand the idea?

words.zh: phr. 换句话说；也就是说
words.example: The project is due tomorrow; in other words, we must finish it tonight.

words.zh: n. 教育家，教育者，教师；教育学家
words.example: As an educator, Mr. Wang always motivates students to ask questions.

words.zh: v. 用勾作为记号；发出滴答声；出租车打表计费；  n. 勾号；（钟表）滴答声；一刹那；蜱虫
words.example: Tick the correct answer and then check your score at the end.

words.zh: n. 趋向，趋势，倾向；癖好，意向；派别
words.example: Teenagers often have a tendency to imitate the body language of their heroes.

words.zh: v. 降低，减少；（缓缓）放下；【航】降低；  adj. 下方的，底部的；较低级的；（数字或数量）较小的
words.example: She lowered her voice so that nobody else could hear her words.

words.zh: vt. 暗示；暗指；意味着；表明
words.example: Crossing your arms may imply that you are not open to new ideas.

words.zh: adv. 几乎不；仅仅； 刚好，不超过；勉强才能
words.example: He could barely keep his eyes open during the long lecture.

words.zh: v. 用下巴夹住；聊天；作引体向上动作；  n. 颏；下巴
words.example: She rested her chin on her hand and listened to the teacher carefully.

words.zh: v. 占据，占领；占用（时间、空间等）；使用，居住（房屋、建筑）；任职，执政；居住；【化】占据
words.example: The final exam will occupy most of our time this month.

words.zh: v. 盯，凝视；  n. 注视
words.example: It is rude to stare at someone for a long time without speaking.

words.zh: n. 天花板；屋顶；上限
words.example: The ceiling of the classroom is so high that it makes the room feel cooler.

words.zh: vt. 使分心；打扰
words.example: A phone notification can distract students during the teacher's explanation.

words.zh: v. 意识到；看待，理解；感知，察觉；认为，认知
words.example: People may perceive the same gesture very differently in different cultures.

words.zh: v. 区别，识别；使显著；辨别；【财】区分；【化】区分，辨别
words.example: It is important to distinguish a genuine smile from a forced one.

words.zh: n. 焦虑；忧虑；担心；害怕；渴望，热望
words.example: Before the speech, she felt a little anxiety but still walked onto the stage.

words.zh: v. 胸部传球；  n. 胸膛，胸部；箱子；胸部
words.example: He held his books close to his chest and walked quietly into the library.

words.zh: adj. 尴尬的，窘迫的，觉得难堪的
words.example: He felt embarrassed when he forgot his lines in front of the whole class.

words.zh: adj. 羞耻的；害臊的；感到惭愧的；难为情的；内疚的
words.example: She was ashamed of making such a careless mistake in the chemistry experiment.

words.zh: adv. 只是，仅仅，只不过
words.example: Don't be upset; the first try is merely a small step toward success.

words.zh: phr. 要求（某人讲话等）；拜访；正式邀请；号召
words.example: The teacher will call on different students to answer questions each day.

words.zh: v. 打扰，因……操心；麻烦；费心，费时；(使)担心，(使)生气，(使)苦恼；  n. 麻烦；不便；烦恼，焦急
words.example: Sorry to bother you, but could you help me with this math problem?

words.zh: v. 哭泣，流泪；（伤口）化脓；  n. 哭泣
words.example: She began to weep quietly when she heard the news about the lost puppy.

words.zh: phr. 在工作；有某种影响
words.example: When two people shake hands, body language is at work.

words.zh: n. 冲突，争执，矛盾；战斗（读作/ˈkɑnˌflɪkt/）；  vi. 冲突，抵触（读作/kənˈflɪkt/）
words.example: A conflict between teammates can affect the whole basketball team's performance.

words.zh: v. 打听，询问；调查
words.example: Please inquire at the office if you want to know your exam results.

words.zh: adv. 最终，最后；根本上
words.example: Ultimately, the success of a project depends on teamwork and effort.

words.zh: v. 调整，调节；校正；适应；（使）习惯；【化】调节，调整；【航】调整
words.example: You should adjust your posture to avoid back pain while studying.

words.zh: vi. 介入，调停；干预，阻挠；  v. 干扰；插嘴，打断(别人的话)
words.example: The teacher had to intervene when the two students argued loudly.

words.zh: vi. 起反应，对……做出反应；（对食物等）有不良反应；起化学反应；  v. 回应
words.example: How did your parents react when you told them about the project?

words.zh: n. 零件，组成部分；【计】组件；【物】分量；  adj. 组成的
words.example: Body language is an important component of everyday communication.

words.zh: vi. 给……上色；  vt. 使更健壮；  n. 语气；语调；色调；腔调；口吻；（尤指肌肉的）坚实，结实；语气，音调
words.example: Her warm tone of voice made the new student feel welcome immediately.
